en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us from his father from Ibrahim b. Hashim from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt. He said: I said to al-Rida (as):
What do you say regarding the Quran? So, he said: It is the word of Allah. Do not go beyond it, and do not seek guidance in other than it, or you will be misguided.
